messages:
Allie (People Ops): hey team — planning a 'Thank You Montage' + microgrant distribution for Q2. short video submissions + handwritten postcard drop + $25 e-gift for everyone who submits + 10x $200 microgrants to reward standout peers. looking for volunteers and logistics help. timeline: submissions open Apr 4-18, assembly week Apr 21-25, distribution targeted May 1. thoughts?
Priya (Finance): quick q — budget ok? any tax flags for global e-gifts? need GL code.
Marco (People Ops Ops): love it. happy to own postcard printing + postage. can we use local vendors for APAC/EMEA to avoid customs + long lead times?
Jen (People Ops): I'll take video submission flow + editing pipeline. can make a short Loom with instructions. suggests 60s cap per clip.
Tom (Global Ops): heads up on payroll/cards cutoffs for UK/DE — some countries treat e-gift cards as taxable. also physical cards crossing borders might hit customs.
Allie (People Ops): noted. Priya — proposed budget math: $25 * 150 people = $3,750 + 10 * $200 = $2,000 + printing/shipping est $800 => total ~ $6,550. propose GL code "Gifts & Recognition" 5124.
Priya (Finance): GL 5124 works. tax note: US <$50 informal gifts ok; DE and UK require reporting if above thresholds. i'll loop in tax ops to confirm per-country treatment. mark e-gifts as non-cash in US docs.
Marco (People Ops Ops): vendor recs: PostPrint Co (US), Shiro Cards (EU), PaperWave (APAC). i'll get quotes and ETA.
Jen (People Ops): Form draft (placeholder): https://forms.gle/thanks-2026 — fields: nominee, video link (max 60s), short reason (140 chars), permission checkbox for sharing at all-hands. add "prefer physical or digital" option.
Allie (People Ops): sharing should be opt-in only. also add opt-out for internal homepage / Slack highlight. Everyone's privacy must be respected.
Tom (Global Ops): volunteers so far: Marco -> fulfillment, Jen -> editing/docs, I can handle customs/shipping labels. need final headcount by Apr 10 to confirm vendor print runs.
HR-bot: Reminder: All-hands sharing requires people ops sign-off & release form. Use template code `release_2026_v1`.
Priya (Finance): payroll/gift-card cutoff: to get e-gifts into accounts by May 1 we need final recipient list by Apr 22. if missed, they'll go out in the next payroll window.
Allie (People Ops): :thumbsup: i'll spin up a short project doc with timeline, roles, and budget tracker. volunteers pls react with :raised_hands: and i'll DM for next steps.
Jen (People Ops): :raised_hands: i'll own the edit queue and Loom guide.
Marco (People Ops Ops): :raised_hands: i'll collect vendor quotes by Apr 6 and share cost breakdown.
Tom (Global Ops): small ask to hiring ops — please try not to schedule major interviews or on-site events during all-hands week (Apr 21-25) if possible; we'd like max attendance for the reveal.
Allie (People Ops): :sparkles: thanks team. planning sync Fri Apr 5 11:00 AM PT — calendar invite coming. i'll post the project doc in #people-ops and add milestone reminders.
